plan.objective: Identify concrete taxonomy defects in files.py with exact line evidence, focusing on unsanitized path construction from user-supplied filename.

steps.description: Read files.py to capture exact source lines for read_upload, including the Path(root) / filename join and read_text call.
steps.success_criterion: Numbered source lines for all of files.py, including the path join and read_text lines, are returned.

steps.description: Analyze files_source_lines for path_traversal: determine whether filename is validated, normalized, or confined under root before joining and reading.
steps.success_criterion: A decision recorded with the exact line number of the join/read, confirming or rejecting path_traversal.

steps.description: Analyze files_source_lines for resource_leak and swallowed_exception around file reading (handle management, exception handling).
steps.success_criterion: Each of resource_leak and swallowed_exception is explicitly confirmed or rejected with cited line numbers.

steps.description: Run the linter on files.py with a security profile to corroborate or surface additional taxonomy-relevant defects.
steps.success_criterion: Linter completes and its diagnostics (or empty result) are recorded with line numbers.

steps.description: Synthesize path_traversal_finding, io_handling_finding, and linter_report into a final deduplicated defect list using only frozen taxonomy categories with line evidence.
steps.success_criterion: Report lists each confirmed defect with one taxonomy category and a specific line number, and contains no style or speculative items.

plan.completion_criterion: final_defect_report enumerates all confirmed taxonomy defects in files.py (at minimum resolving path_traversal) with exact line evidence and no out-of-taxonomy items.
